description:
Mark Lawless Auctioneers are delighted to present this beautifully modernised four-bedroom detached home, ideally situated on an impressive 0.49-acre site at Drumcooley, Edenderry, Co. Offaly.
Extending to approximately 216 sq. m (2,325 sq. ft) over two floors, this impressive property has been thoughtfully transformed to create a spacious and comfortable family home, successfully combining character and charm with the comfort, practicality and energy efficiency expected of modern living.
The accommodation is bright, spacious and exceptionally well presented throughout. At the heart of the home is a superb open-plan kitchen, dining and family area, complete with a wood pellet stove, creating a warm and welcoming space for everyday family life and entertaining.
A generously proportioned sitting room provides an inviting and comfortable separate reception space, with a feature electric fire adding to the welcoming atmosphere. The entrance hall features an attractive wooden staircase with contemporary glass side panels. Also on the ground floor is a versatile playroom, which could readily serve as a fifth bedroom, home office or additional reception room, depending on the needs of the new owners.
Upstairs, there are four well-proportioned bedrooms, including an impressive master bedroom with en-suite and walk-in wardrobe, offering excellent storage and a comfortable private retreat. The remaining bedrooms are generously sized and are served by the main family bathroom. The first floor also benefits from access to a balcony.
Considerable attention has been given to the home's comfort and energy performance. Heating is provided by an efficient air-to-water heating system, while the property also boasts an impressive B energy rating, contributing to a warm, comfortable and energy-efficient home. The BER may also enable qualifying purchasers to avail of a green mortgage, subject to individual lender terms and criteria.
Externally, the property is equally impressive. The residence stands on a generous 0.49-acre mature site, with established lawns and gardens to both the front and rear, providing an attractive setting and excellent outdoor space.
A standout feature of the property is the substantial workshop/garage positioned to the rear. This impressive building offers considerable versatility and is ideal for secure storage, vehicle enthusiasts, tradespeople, hobbies, workshop use or a variety of other purposes, subject to any necessary planning requirements.
The combination of a spacious and flexible family home, generous 0.49-acre site and impressive detached workshop/garage makes this a particularly attractive and versatile property.
Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, space and excellent facilities this superb home has to offer.
